task.question: Across infectious diseases, what infectious-dose measurements (including ID50, HID50, and MID) and basic reproduction-number (R0) estimates have been reported, and what evidence supports or contradicts a relationship between infectious dose and R0?

population: Every completed numerical transition on the fresh live Episode tree, stratified by grain and structural path.

intervention.productive_baseline: median nonzero realized hypervolume credit in the trailing estimator window, carrying the last identifiable baseline across a barren window
intervention.one_result_resolution: smallest positive current hypervolume change from one additional unique identity on one open required channel

bounds.interpretation: unbounded acquisition; only numerical Episode verdicts or physical/source failure ends count as method outcomes

prediction: Once an adaptive Episode has an identifiable one-result resolution or productive-unit baseline, its recorded gamma becomes an explicit nonzero efficiency threshold whenever either component is positive. Repeated low predicted marginal credit then produces a yield_stop before continued low-value sampling; the full run is allowed to end only through its own live tree.
falsification: The policy remains ready with gamma zero while a positive component is recorded, advances a stop streak while both components are unavailable, or eligible adaptive Episodes repeatedly remain below their recorded positive gamma without reaching their declared streak and yield_stop.
confirmation: acquisition_episodes.json contains a ThresholdUpdate on every counted controller verdict
gamma exactly equals the maximum of the recorded one-result resolution and 0.1 times the recorded productive baseline
threshold_insufficient transitions do not advance flat_streak
at least one eligible adaptive Episode reaches yield_stop under its own recorded threshold history
